results.description: UTF-8 BOM, fixed eight-column header, empty input is header only
Records are ascending by date without changing the caller input
Commas, quotes, CR/LF and Korean text survive CSV parsing
Spreadsheet formulas in text are neutralized; negative numbers stay numeric
Missing source timestamp exports a blank cell without inventing a timestamp
Replay scope is rejected explicitly even with plausible weather data
Only the eight public fields export; no raw payload/session/credentials
Last stored records remain exportable after a failed refresh; no network request
Existing core, SQL storage, API response and browser weather regression suites pass
